_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment (batch S6 Silver Cross). Sourced 2026-07-05. Silver Cross Jet ultra-compact cabin stroller; Clek lists 'Jet 3, Jet 4'. Specs given for Jet 3 (Jet 4 shares the frame/fold). Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Silver Cross Jet 3 / Jet 4 (ultra-compact cabin stroller)

clekListed.clekRow: Silver Cross Jet 3, Jet 4 — Jet Car Seat Adapters

priceSources.retailer: Silver Cross US (DTC, Jet 5 current gen)

specs._weightNote: Jet 3 = 13.6 lb. The newer Jet 5 (same line, US DTC) is ~15.87 lb excl. bumper bar.
specs._dimsNote: Jet 3 folded ~55 x 30 x 20 cm (21.65 x 11.8 x 7.08 in) — small-suitcase, cabin-approved, self-standing and wheelable via the bumper bar. Open ~35.43 x 17.7 x 39.5 in (Little Folks NYC / MadeForMums).

brake.type: flip-flop-friendly foot parking brake; lockable swivel front wheels

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth (multi-position seat recline; car-seat or carrycot compatible)

safety.standards: ASTM F833 / 16 CFR 1227 (US market). No specific standard is published on the Silver Cross US spec page; Silver Cross is UK-origin (EN 1888 in home market, not stated for US units). Marketed as TSA / airline-cabin approved. No named third-party certification (e.g. JPMA) published.
safety.notes: 5-point harness; one-hand compact fold; stands independently folded.
safety.otherCerts: EN 1888 (UK/EU home market; not stated for US units); marketed as TSA / airline-cabin approved

specs.foldType: one-hand ultra-compact cabin fold, self-standing, airline-cabin / TSA approved
specs.tires: small foam/plastic swivel wheels with dynamic spring suspension, lockable

notes: The lightest/most-compact Silver Cross and the best fit for the light/compact city+shopping goal (~13.6 lb, cabin fold). Clek lists Jet 3 & Jet 4; the frame/fold carried into the current Jet 5 (US DTC, ~15.87 lb, out of stock at check). Jet 3 in-stock supply is thin in the US — Little Folks NYC listed $404.99 but sold out. One Jet Car Seat Adapter ($59.99) fits Jet 2020/3/4/5 and mounts the Clek Liing.
